Hi Michael,

Thanks for the quick onboarding calls last week. As part of our procurement checklist for vendor approvals I need a short interim assurance/bridge confirmation that covers the period after your most recent SOC 2 Type II report. Our current requirement is coverage for the period starting 2027-08-01 through today (we anticipate we will need coverage through the end of September).

Can Redwood provide a signed bridge letter or attestation that:
- Confirms there have been no material changes to the control environment since the report period end date (2027-07-31), or
- If there were changes, describes them and points to mitigating controls/evidence.

We're also collecting a few artifacts to satisfy internal auditors: a redacted SOC 2 Type II report, KMS/key-rotation summary, and evidence of change control for any high-impact infra changes in Aug. I attached our RFP checklist (Aurora_RFP_SIG_2027.xlsx) — items 3, 5, and 9 on that sheet are the priority.

Target timeline: procurement would like the bridge confirmation within 72 hours if possible to keep the contract timeline on track. If you need longer, please state a clear ETA. Also let me know if you prefer signing a short bridge letter via DocuSign or sending a PDF signed by an officer.

Thanks — we can loop in legal if necessary.

3) Evidence we can produce within 48–72 hours: KMS/key rotation log summary (redacted), change-control tickets for high-impact deploys (August snapshot), and a system-configuration manifest for our production GPU clusters.

Attached: redwood_soc2_2027_typeII_redacted.pdf and a draft bridge letter (proposed_bridge_letter_draft.docx). Rishi, can you review the draft language and confirm we can sign via DocuSign? Laura — pls confirm the KMS summary export and change-control snapshots are ready to share.
